Skincare campaign · Studio concept

Skincare Objects

Self-initiated concept · Not commissioned client work

  • Creative direction
  • Campaign concept
  • AI-assisted visual production

The challenge

Explore how a skincare product can become the focal point of a bold, cohesive launch campaign without relying on product claims.

The strategy

Use one memorable material idea: warm orange glass. Repeat its color, light and circular geometry to create a recognizable campaign language.

Design & engineering

This concept pairs an AI-assisted product composition with a proposed digital campaign direction. Reflective surfaces and a tightly controlled orange palette make the product the central visual subject.

The delivery

A visual campaign concept presented to demonstrate creative direction and AI-assisted production. It is not a launched client engagement; packaging text is illustrative and no sales or performance results are claimed.
